Wildlife

More than 200 species live in the park. Please give all of them room: 25 yards for elk and deer, 100 yards for bears. If an animal changes what it's doing because of you, you're too close.

Roosevelt elk
A herd of about sixty grazes Halloran Meadows at dawn and dusk. The bulls bugle through September and you can hear it from the lodge.
Common loon
Two pairs nest on Echo Lake. Listen for them around dusk.
Great horned owl
Lives in Cathedral Stand year round. You can often hear one from the lodge porch after dark.
Black bear
Around forty in the park. Every campsite has a bear locker. Please use it, and yes, that includes toothpaste.
Seen something we missed?
Tell us at any ranger station. Good sightings go in the park log with your name on them.
